review_type: targeted pre-outcome adversarial screen; not blinded accuracy review and not ground truth
limitations: The reviewer knew legacy sampling strata and selected the sample, so this is pre-outcome but not fully blinded.
Exact RGB frames are sparse visual evidence and do not directly measure ego braking, speed, or steering.
A label disagreement is an adjudication trigger, not proof that the operational oracle is wrong.
Some clips may contain multiple visible triggers that a one-record-per-unit oracle cannot represent separately.
